Sentence (English): We bought the Bosch because our daughter has one that is a year or two old and it cleans beautifully.
Comments (English): [ READ BEFORE BUYING A BOSCH DISHWASHER ] || ---------------- || We bought the Bosch because our daughter has one that is a year or two old and it cleans beautifully. We learned, however, that Bosch has made significant changes, apparently, since she bought hers. This is a great dishwasher when it comes to getting the dishes clean and it is very quiet, so why the one star rating? I gave it only one star for several reasons. 1. This dishwasher is narrower than our old one and most other dishwashers on the market. When it was installed, there was a noticeable and ugly gap between it and the cabinets. The main part of the dishwasher is narrower than the top panel with the controls and even it was narrower than other dishwashers which exaggerated the gap of the rest of the dishwasher with the cabinets and made it look even uglier. (I went to Best Buy and measured the different dishwasher brands after the install.). 2. The interior of the dishwasher is smaller than any standard dishwasher we've ever owned. 3. Perhaps the most annoying thing about the Bosch, is the tines are angled, not straight which is a huge challenge when loading dishes, bowls, the coffee pot or any even somewhat larger item. In addition, the tines are very close together making it impossible to load even a small lid for a very small Corning Ware bowl. We used to have stoneware dishes. I sincerely doubt they would fit inside the tines, the space is that narrow. As if that wasn't enough of a challenge, they have different sections where the tines run in opposite directions, i.e. at a right angle to the other section making loading plates and, especially, other items even more impossible than the narrow tines make it already. Conclusion. If you currently use most, or all of the space in your dishwasher to run a load, plan on having to do two loads, not one, to get your dishes done. It's a shame Bosch designed this machine so poorly and made it smaller on the interior and exterior than all other standard size dishwashers as it does a great job of cleaning. For these reasons, I cannot recommend the Bosch. We replaced the Bosch with a KitchenAid with the third rack on top. I am happy to report that the KitchenAid cleans just as well as the Bosch, is just as quiet as the Bosch, fits the space just like other dishwashers without an ugly, large gap and has a very, very large interior and is extremely easy to load and handles large objects and/or odd-shaped dishes very well.

Sentence (English): The unit operates efficiently, but I have some annoyances re its operation.
Comments (English): [ Its Acceptable ] || ---------------- || The unit operates efficiently, but I have some annoyances re its operation. In the description of the product and the manual, it states that it had a 30 minute cycle. As our old dishwashers had a 30 minute cycle we thought that this would be the same, but NO, the 30 minute cycle on this unit is just like a rinse cycle. It does sort of wash but there is no drying of dishes inside on completion of cycle. So we are forced to use the one hour cycle with extra drying time as without the extra drying time the dishes are still damp on completion of the cycle. The fact that the 30 minute cycle is not actually a complete washing cycle, should be annotated either in the description or in the manual. Drying time should be included in each program and should be of sufficient heat to actually dry the dishes without having to use extra drying time. More time running the more it costs to run.

Sentence (English): We built a home 8 years ago and put in a Frigidaire dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher!  ] || ---------------- || We built a home 8 years ago and put in a Frigidaire dishwasher. From the start this thing would leak out of both corners when it was done washing; repair man said it was the way I loaded my dishes which wasn't the case I did just as instructions advised. Also if you didn't pre-rinse your dishes with the Frigidaire all that happened was your food would stick on and dry to the dish. After having to keep a towel down for each load I decided to purchase a new dishwasher. Guess what; I loaded this dishwasher the same way as the old one and it DID NOT leak. The very first time I used this dishwasher I just wanted to see how good it was; so we didn't rinse anything before putting it in the dishwasher (including a frying pan and spatula used for frying eggs). Evening came out extremely clean with the exception of the frying pan that did have fried on eggs (which normally we have to scrap off anyways) but is took a lot off of the pan. I would highly recommend this product and I for sure would NEVER purchase a Frigidaria product just because it is a little cheaper; remember you get what you pay for.

Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher with some cheap plastic parts ] || ---------------- || This is the second 800 series dishwasher I'm buying. I like most of the things about this dishwasher:* quiet* third rack is great* cleans and dries wellI didn't like:The previous one I had was a fully integrated dishwasher. It had a wood panel to match our cabinets. I had a lot of problems with the door not closing well, not staying in place, etc.After taking the covers off, I saw that both the door hinges and the door return mechanism were made of (cheap) plastic and I think were just not able to handle the weight of the wood panel. I bought the stainless steel version now and I hope that with the lighter door weight, pieces won't warp or break. The other thing that I found with Bosch is how hard it is to schedule service for them. It can take multiple weeks to get someone to service it.

Sentence (English): I purchased this in July of 2022.
Comments (English): [ Great but not great ] || ---------------- || I purchased this in July of 2022. I love it and I hate it. A lot of the reviews spoke of how quiet it is. This was one of the main reasons I looked at this model because I have an open concept kitchen, dining area, family room. My previous dishwasher was very noisy. This one is super quiet. You can stand beside it and have a conversation whispering and the person across the room will still be able to hear you. Yes, it is that quiet. And it cleans like a superstar. In all the months I've had it only two things have come out that still had something on them and I think they were positioned in the dishwasher in a way that prevented them from getting cleaned. So it cleans fantastically. It has three racks. At first I did use the top rack but found that it took up space that I needed and it is removable so I took it out. I really haven't missed it. I need the space in the middle rack for Tall Glasses and even though it will go up and down 3 levels, which is nice, if it went down far enough to accommodate Tall Glasses it would hit things on the bottom rack but if I moved the middle rack up to clear the bottom the glasses would hit the top rack. I found I just don't use the top rack all that much. It's designed for silverware primarily but I use the silverware caddy at the bottom for that. This unit does have a lot of settings. One of the nice features is the opportunity for a dual setting. You can have the top/middle rack on a gentler setting than the bottom, which is nice if you have plastic ware there or lighter items that a heavier spray would bang around. It also has the ability to do a half load so if you only want to do something on the bottom or the middle/top you can. That's a nice if you need to get something specific clean but don't need the whole dishwasher filled. The silverware caddy at the bottom has slots that will hold most silverware. I open one side to place my items with handles that won't fit into the slots. Drying plastic ware is a bit of an issue for most dishwashers but this one offers additional dry settings which are helpful. There is also a setting for night dry which helps to keep condensation from building up on the dishes overnight. I have found that using Jet-Dry significantly improves drying. You are able to adjust the amount of Jet-Dry that it uses and it also lets you know when it's getting low. I like to make sure my dishes are sanitized. While this unit does not have a sanitizing feature specifically, it does have a high temp feature which I use. I typically use the normal cycle, high temperature with extra dry & it takes about 3 hours & 11 minutes. That seems like a long time but a lot of that time is not with the machine "going". It will spray and rinse and spray some more and then it will sit to soak so some of that time is soak time. But my dishes get clean and that's the purpose. I have used the Express setting which cleans just as well as the normal cycle in a shorter time for items that weren't heavily soiled. I have not needed to use the heavy cycle even for baked on dishes. They get clean on the settings I use. It has a lovely chime and displays End when finished. Now having sung all the Praises for this machine it does have some serious issues for me and I've noticed others have commented on this as well. The rack design is terrible as far as the tine placement goes. It's pretty obvious the folks (guys) that developed this did not take it home and let the wife try it out for a few days. It would have only taken her one day and she'd have told them quite quickly this is not working so take it back and fix it. The tines are too far apart at the bottom and things just don't fit well. I have pasta bowls and they will only fit in certain spaces but that unfortunately makes it difficult for my other items to fit well. The tines have the ability to flip down. The problem is once they flip down a couple of times they seem to lose their strength to stay up. If you have anything that leans against them they fall. The middle rack bottom is not designed flat but has angles at created to hold a certain size cup or glass but not everybody has that size. Trying to get lids for plastic ware and other things to fit is a constant battle. This dishwasher was designed for a lovely 12 place setting dinner party. Not many people have a dishwasher just for a 12 Place dinner setting. We do have plastic things and children's cups and odd size coffee cups and the weird shaped bowls. This machine's design is really difficult to accommodate that. I'm still struggling to make things fit right. I feel like a lot of times I have wasted space that I can't put something in because it won't sit correctly and flips over. The top rack is specifically made for silverware. You can put a few flat things in there but any spatulas, etc., that have much of an angle to them will not fit. Overall, this is a great dishwasher despite the issues with the tine placement. It is super quiet and does clean exceptionally well. I do a bit of juggling to get things to fit but it is the best one for cleaning and quietness I've ever had. If you can get past the tine placement issues, which I have for the most part, it does the job very well and super quietly!

Comments (English): [ Great features, but some quirky design issues. ] || ---------------- || We got this unit to replace a Kitchen Aid that was 6 years old and started leaking. This unit was delivered and installed by Home Depot. The unit was NOT leveled. We had to level it ourselves. The upper dish rack is adjustable up and down, but if we adjust it all the way down, the adjustment tabs hit the door gasket when pulling it out and pushing it back in. It will tear the gasket if we leave it in the lowered position. Not sure why it clears the gasket in the upmost position, but not the lowered position. The bottom dish rack rolls like it has no ball bearings in the wheels. It will barely go over the gap between the tub and the door panel without lifting it with two hands, even when the rack is empty. The movement of both of these dish racks is day and night from the smooth movement of our Kitchen Aid unit. Very disappointing how rough they are to move. The dishes do clean well, and the drying cycle works perfectly. The SmartHQ wireless connection is working, but we don't see much real value in it as of yet.

Sentence (English): appearance: good shape, glass panel, not too big, as long as it is narrow enough, and only 500mm in height.
Comments (English): Appearance: good shape, glass panel, not too big, as long as it is narrow enough, and only 500mm in height. The 5 sides of the inner tank are made of stainless steel, but the bottom is made of plastic, so the bottom is generally the oiliest after washing, but the problem is not too big. Washing capacity: It is no problem for a family of 3 to eat at one time. The height is only 500mm, which makes the soup bowl twisted when placed in it, which is not as good as the Panasonic one. The inner pot of the rice cooker can also be put in, and can be cleaned, but it will be crowded after being put in, and it is easy to not clean it. Cleaning ability: Let me talk about the obvious shortcomings: the cleaning ability of the upper layer is very poor, no matter what the procedure is, the lower layer is basically no problem as long as it is not blocked, the reason is that the spray arms on the upper layer are too small, the water pressure is not good, and the two spray arms on the lower layer are water There is no problem with the pressure. In addition, the official diagram of the upper layer is wrong. It should be placed according to the way I put it in Figure 6. The mouth of the four bowls should face the upper left. Class or can only put down the layer to wash. I have tried several procedures many times, using Wanban small turmeric dishwashing blocks and small turmeric dishwashing powder (this is the more expensive kind), the summary is as follows: super strong washing and ordinary washing are actually similar, and ordinary washing is not clean Yes, super washing is not clean. ECO washing is too time-consuming and does not save much water. Quick washing is a waste of water and electricity. Basically, even ordinary rice can’t be cleaned. Fruit washing is similar to seafood washing, and washing vegetables Anything like that is fine. In addition, the water softener cannot be adjusted by AI, it has to be adjusted manually. I used to automatically adjust the AI at 3 levels, but there was white residue after washing, and manual 2 levels will be fine.
Comments (Original): 外形外观：造型不错，玻璃面板，体积也不大，只要是够窄，而且只有500mm高度。内胆5面是不锈钢的，但是底部是塑料的，所以底部一般洗完最油，其实问题也不算太大。洗涤容量：3口之家一次吃饭是没问题的，高度只有500mm导致汤碗放进去很变扭，这点不如松下的那款。电饭煲内胆也是可以放进去的，能洗干净，不过放了以后就很挤，容易别的洗不干净。清洁能力：说一下明显的缺点:上层清洗能力很差，无论什么程序都一样，下层基本只要不挡住都没问题，原因在于上层的喷臂太小了，水压不行，下层2个喷臂水压没问题，此外官方上层摆放示意图是错的，应该按照我图六放的方式放，四个碗碗口朝左上才行，这样效果还好一些，至少饭粒洗的掉，但火锅调料之类的还是只能放下层洗。几个程序都试了很多次，使用碗伴小黄姜洗碗块和小黄姜洗碗粉（这是比较贵的那种），总结如下:超强洗和普通洗其实差不多，普通洗洗不干净的，超强洗也是洗不干净的，ECO洗太浪费时间，而且不省多少水，快速洗完全是浪费水和电，基本连普通米饭也洗不干净，水果洗和海鲜洗差不多，洗蔬菜之类的都可以。此外软水器不能用AI调节，要手动调节，我之前AI自动3档，结果一直洗完有白色残留，手动2档就好了。

Sentence (English): I'll start with the positives.
Comments (English): [ OK dishwasher, but falls short for the price. ] || ---------------- || I'll start with the positives. This dishwasher cleans well, is very quiet, and the unit has a well-constructed sturdy feel to it. However, at this price point more is needed to win me over. The negatives:. This unit has a heating element for drying. This means nothing plastic can go in the lower rack, unless you turn off the drying option for the cycle. Shame on me for not catching this in the specs, but every other dishwasher I've seen at this price uses hot air drying. After 10 years of using a dishwasher with hot air drying (that is, not worrying about plastic down low) I'm not looking to go backwards. The drying is not great. You need to use the extra dry option to get acceptable drying. The vent in the door (the cutout in the upper-left near the handle) leaks water on the floor when you open the door to unload the dishwasher. The wash options are pretty limited, and there's no time indicator (just a light on the front). And finally, the rack layout it not practical. I thought the cup washing section of the 3rd rack would be a great option, but in reality it is a huge limiting factor. It takes away all flexibility in the use of the 3rd rack. The \"flat\" part of the 3rd rack (right side) is pretty small, and is usually taken up by anything plastic, like kids stuff. Likewise, the 2nd rack is very height limited underneath the cup section. Even on the right side, the 2nd rack doesn't have great clearance. My wine glasses are too tall to fit in the stem holder area. Also, a bike water bottle (standard 26 oz bottle) does not fit. And this is with the 2nd rack in it's lower position. Back to the cup section: I don't have oversized cups by any stretch, yet they barely clear the dishwasher \"ceiling\" (and sometimes rub the gasket when I close the rack). And the bike bottles don't fit here either. These are the things you don't really figure out until you start trying to use the dishwasher in your home with your stuff. Bottom line, the cup washer is more gimmick than useful, and really cramps the layout of the whole dishwasher. At this price point, these are too many concessions for my needs. So, the unit will be returned. This was my second choice anyway, but I needed to go with this model due to an urgent need to replace a dishwasher that died. Now, I need to go elsewhere to find my first choice of dishwasher. One final point, to end on another positive: the installation was fairly easy due to the generous amount of clearance underneath. However, the electrical connection was difficult because the junction box is JUST too high to easily get to it. Despite that, it was an easy install (and will be an easy removal, too).

I am super happy with my new gift.

When you look at new DW's, you see that they have many new neat features but the build quality across the board is pretty poor. Ends up being a bit of a gamble as to which one to buy. The DW runs really quiet and the internal layout of the two racks allows more items to fit than in previous model. It's only been a few weeks but so far so good.One thing to keep in mind that is not related to how the DW operates. On day of delivery, Home Depot would not install the dishwasher. Installer said we had to have a shut-off valve under sink which we did not have. We have PEX system which does have a shut-off vale on the PEX manifold. And it turned out that there also was a shutoff in the rear of the undercounter dishwasher compartment. But HD still would not install the dishwasher. So, we were left with the new dishwasher sitting in our kitchen and the old broken one still in place under counter. We are DIY people, and we installed the DW on our own. HD refunded our installation fee and the takeaway fee. and we later returned the installation parts we did not need. For us, it turned out OK and we saved $. But non DIY'ers would have been in a jam having to get an alternate installer that would almost certainly ending up costing them way for more to install.We are happy with the DW and would buy same unit again.

Sentence (English): I'll start with the positives.
Comments (English): [ OK dishwasher, but falls short for the price. ] || ---------------- || I'll start with the positives. This dishwasher cleans well, is very quiet, and the unit has a well-constructed sturdy feel to it. However, at this price point more is needed to win me over.The negatives:This unit has a heating element for drying. This means nothing plastic can go in the lower rack, unless you turn off the drying option for the cycle. Shame on me for not catching this in the specs, but every other dishwasher I've seen at this price uses hot air drying. After 10 years of using a dishwasher with hot air drying (that is, not worrying about plastic down low) I'm not looking to go backwards.The drying is not great. You need to use the extra dry option to get acceptable drying.The vent in the door (the cutout in the upper-left near the handle) leaks water on the floor when you open the door to unload the dishwasher.The wash options are pretty limited, and there's no time indicator (just a light on the front).And finally, the rack layout it not practical. I thought the cup washing section of the 3rd rack would be a great option, but in reality it is a huge limiting factor. It takes away all flexibility in the use of the 3rd rack. The "flat" part of the 3rd rack (right side) is pretty small, and is usually taken up by anything plastic, like kids stuff. Likewise, the 2nd rack is very height limited underneath the cup section. Even on the right side, the 2nd rack doesn't have great clearance. My wine glasses are too tall to fit in the stem holder area. Also, a bike water bottle (standard 26 oz bottle) does not fit. And this is with the 2nd rack in it's lower position.Back to the cup section: I don't have oversized cups by any stretch, yet they barely clear the dishwasher "ceiling" (and sometimes rub the gasket when I close the rack). And the bike bottles don't fit here either. These are the things you don't really figure out until you start trying to use the dishwasher in your home with your stuff. Bottom line, the cup washer is more gimmick than useful, and really cramps the layout of the whole dishwasher.At this price point, these are too many concessions for my needs. So, the unit will be returned. This was my second choice anyway, but I needed to go with this model due to an urgent need to replace a dishwasher that died. Now, I need to go elsewhere to find my first choice of dishwasher.One final point, to end on another positive: the installation was fairly easy due to the generous amount of clearance underneath. However, the electrical connection was difficult because the junction box is JUST too high to easily get to it. Despite that, it was an easy install (and will be an easy removal, too).

However, at this price point more is needed to win me over.The negatives:This unit has a heating element for drying. This means nothing plastic can go in the lower rack, unless you turn off the drying option for the cycle. Shame on me for not catching this in the specs, but every other dishwasher I've seen at this price uses hot air drying. After 10 years of using a dishwasher with hot air drying (that is, not worrying about plastic down low) I'm not looking to go backwards.The drying is not great. You need to use the extra dry option to get acceptable drying.The vent in the door (the cutout in the upper-left near the handle) leaks water on the floor when you open the door to unload the dishwasher.The wash options are pretty limited, and there's no time indicator (just a light on the front).And finally, the rack layout it not practical. I thought the cup washing section of the 3rd rack would be a great option, but in reality it is a huge limiting factor. It takes away all flexibility in the use of the 3rd rack. The 'flat' part of the 3rd rack (right side) is pretty small, and is usually taken up by anything plastic, like kids stuff. Likewise, the 2nd rack is very height limited underneath the cup section. Even on the right side, the 2nd rack doesn't have great clearance. My wine glasses are too tall to fit in the stem holder area. Also, a bike water bottle (standard 26 oz bottle) does not fit. And this is with the 2nd rack in it's lower position.Back to the cup section: I don't have oversized cups by any stretch, yet they barely clear the dishwasher 'ceiling' (and sometimes rub the gasket when I close the rack). And the bike bottles don't fit here either. These are the things you don't really figure out until you start trying to use the dishwasher in your home with your stuff. Bottom line, the cup washer is more gimmick than useful, and really cramps the layout of the whole  dishwasher.At this price point, these are too many concessions for my needs. So, the unit will be returned. This was my second choice anyway, but I needed to go with this model due to an urgent need to replace a dishwasher that died. Now, I need to go elsewhere to find my first choice of dishwasher.One final point, to end on another positive: the installation was fairly easy due to the generous amount of clearance underneath. However, the electrical connection was difficult because the junction box is JUST too high to easily get to it. Despite that, it was an easy install (and will be an easy removal, too).

Sentence (English): The laundry pods in the video and pictures are for everyone to perceive the size, not for washing dishes.
Comments (English): The laundry pods in the video and pictures are for everyone to perceive the size, not for washing dishes. Space: The physical volume is large, and the internal dishwashing space can be adjusted according to your actual situation. The upper and lower dish racks are detachable. I have tried the iron net and iron pan of the range hood, and they can all be put down. Cleaning ability: very powerful, even after trying to place it randomly, it can be cleaned. In the picture, the iron net of the range hood and the collector are covered with thick grease before washing, and it is almost removed after washing. If you look carefully, there may still be some, but at this time, you can quickly remove it by dipping some hot water and scrubbing. Take a step back and think that the dishwasher will help you solve most of the cases, and the remaining stubborn ones can be easily removed by hand. Share your own situation: I have tried stubborn grease kitchen utensils that stick to my hands, and I have to wipe them vigorously with a wire ball, and some dead corners are difficult to clean. It can be easily solved with a dishwasher, even if it doesn’t work the first time, it’s basically solved after washing the next batch. Even if it is still there, it can be easily removed by wiping it by hand. The old kitchen utensils at home are a little rusty, and the dishwasher can't wash them, so I can only buy citric acid powder to wash them myself. (I have thought about washing it in the dishwasher, but I am afraid it will damage the machine, so I dare not wash it with citric acid.) When the NFC of the machine touches the sticker, ios is available, and the phone responds after about 1 second, so you can Set the dishwashing program on the app. Simple buying advice for those who want to buy a dishwasher: there is no need to doubt the ability to wash dishes, and the stubborn ones that cannot be washed are easy to remove. If you wash it by hand, the stubbornness is not so easy to remove.
Comments (Original): 视频和图中洗衣凝珠是为让大家感知大小，不是用于洗碗。空间：实物体积大，内部洗碗空间可根据自己实际情况调整。上下洗碗架子均可拆卸。试过油烟机的铁网、铁锅，均能放下。清洗能力：非常强大，试过非常随意的乱放均能清洗干净。图中油烟机铁网、收集器洗之前都是有厚重的油脂覆盖住，清洗后几乎去除掉。如果你仔细看可能还是会有些，但这时候自己沾点热水擦洗很快就能去掉了。退一步想洗碗机帮你解决大部份情况，剩下的顽固很容易自己手动除掉。分享自己的情况：试过黏手的顽固油脂厨具，必须用铁丝球大力擦，有些死角还难清洗。用洗碗机可以轻松解决，哪怕第一次不行，放到洗下一批再洗基本解决了。即使还有，自己手动擦很轻松就去掉。家里老厨具有些生锈了，这个洗碗机洗不了，只能自己买柠檬酸粉洗。（我有想过试试放洗碗机里面洗，但怕会损伤机器，还是不敢放柠檬酸洗了）机器NFC一碰贴纸，ios可用，手机放过去1秒左右有反应，这样就可在app上设置洗碗程序。给想买洗碗机的人简单购买建议：洗碗能力很强不需要怀疑，洗不了的顽固很容易去掉。要是手洗，顽固可没那么容易去掉。

Sentence (English): The home is well-decorated, and I don’t want to change the cabinets.
Comments (English): The home is well-decorated, and I don’t want to change the cabinets. I want to choose a desktop dishwasher. I have seen Panasonic, Midea, and Hualing. After a week of comparison, I chose this one. It is suitable for our family of three. There are not too many dishes for each meal, and No need to change the water supply, 5 liters each time, especially water-saving, square shape, white, it matches my cabinet very well, the noise is acceptable, just the sound of water flow, I bought it and washed it first, the dishes are very clean , take it out and warm it up. There are also shortcomings, such as needing to manually pour water, not being able to wash pots, etc. It is impossible to ask for perfection in a dishwasher at this price, and we can accept and overcome the shortcomings. It can save me half an hour of washing dishes every day, and it is worth it. up.
Comments (Original): 家里精装修，不想对橱柜改动，想选择台式洗碗机，松下，美的，华凌都看了，比较一个星期之后，选择了这台，适合我们一家三口，每顿饭碗盘不太多，而且不用改动上水，每次5升，特别省水，外形方方正正，白色的，跟我家橱柜也很配，噪音能接受，就是水流声，买回来先洗了个快速洗，碗盘很干净，拿出来热热的。缺点也有，需要手动倒水，不能洗锅之类的，这个价位的洗碗机不可能要求完美，缺点也都是我们能接受克服的，每天能节省我半个小时的洗碗时间，也值了。

Comments (English): [ Our new Bosch Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) This is a very well featured dishwasher for the price point and looks stylish as well. All of the features described by Bosch are true so I will not repeat. The two areas that are negatives to us are as follows. The front panel is flush to the front, so you have to bend down to read all the setting options. When you press the on/off button only the previous setting you used becomes lit. It is difficult to read all of the other options available. I would like to have all buttons be lit when you turn on the unit with the previous setting flashing. That way if you want to use the other options you can see them to choose. Maybe a software/firmware update can do this. The other thing is the wifi option and connectrivity is of little value other than software/firmware updates but I cannot find out how to do this on once loged in from the app. Other than that this is a fantastic, high performance dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I love my new dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I Love It. except for one thing. ] || ---------------- || I love my new dishwasher. My dishes come out clean, no greasy residue. There is a nighttime feature that air dries through the night. There's no water remaining in the tops of cups in the morning when I use this. It has a third drawer on the top that is not very deep, but it is perfect for container lids, overflow silverware, rubber spatulas, sponges, knives, anything flat. There are little teeth in which the silverware can be placed on edge so quite a bit of silverware can be loaded if you aren't using the silverware basket for some reason. The second drawer down (which used to be the top drawer) has four dish separator sections. Two of the divider sections have a side that will lay down flat so you can put in small pans or larger items. The whole drawer can be raised and lowered a few inches to accommodate tall items in either the second drawer or the lower drawer. I really like this option. The makes it more versatile.The bottom drawer holds the silverware basket. I really like this basket as the lid will hold silverware vertically and separated so that they don't nest. Also, there are two separate lids that lift so you can put in small items then close the lid. The small items are now contained so they don't fly. Or you can put in long cooking tools or knives. The bottom basket also has four separator sections. The prong set in two sections each fold down creating a large flat area to accommodate larger items. The bottom drawer is my problem area. It doesn't have a groove for the wheels to glide in which allows it to go off track easily. It slides easily enough when it is not loaded; however, if there is any weight in the drawer, it goes off track. I need to stand directly in front of it and push with both hands to guide it in. If not, it will go off track and will need to be wrestled back in place. Other than that issue, this is an excellent product but couldn't give it five stars as it really has been a problem for me.

So I also bought a 4GL model. I thought I'd regret it later. Anyway, today, I finally installed it. Since our kitchen isn't standard, I could have had an LG technician install it, but I found a cheaper place, so I had them do it elsewhere. They installed it today without any problems. The LG dishwasher technician contacted me in advance and told me I might need to change the product and delivery date due to price and specifications. He said it was fine and told me to install it at a convenient time, so I talked to him several times to coordinate and install it. Thank you. He also gave me a thorough explanation after the installation. It took an hour from the installation to the explanation. However, in person, the sink is dark, and the dishwasher is a dark green, almost black. It goes much better and looks even better. Beige would have been nice, but I think I made a good purchase in green. The product I received came with a tablet detergent dispenser. He said it had only been a few days since it was added, and he said he might have received a product without one, but he said he received one with it. I was happy to hear that the tablet detergent dispenser in the door compartment sometimes hardens instead of dissolving, so they added it. I'm planning to use a water-soluble tablet detergent. I won't be using the door-side detergent compartment. I'll just put it in the tablet compartment installed in the third basket. ^^ It seems convenient and good. When I opened the product, I was a bit suspicious because it was wet. They said they'd test it before shipping it. ^^ They even put a kitchen towel around the drain. They told me to wait a few days to see if it leaks or not. I've only tested it once and haven't used the dishwasher properly. I'll start using it well tomorrow. ^^ I'll write another review after using it for a few days. . Review after a few days: I ran the dishwasher before going out today. It's called a pre-cleaning. If I didn't pre-clean it: Cleaning the strainer (?) on the bottom becomes more of a hassle. If you set it to the standard, it includes the hot air drying time. Close to 2 hours. If you don't need the hot air drying, you can press the button to turn it off and the dishes will be washed in the standard course in less than an hour. (Added; On February 7th, I canceled the hot air drying on the standard course. When I went to check if the door was open after the dishes were done, warm air was blowing out. I don't know if it's to cool down the high temperature that was created while washing the dishes~~~, but it's blowing out warm air like when the hot air drying is done~~ However, unlike when the hot air drying is done, the wind noise stops when I touch the door. Unlike when the hot air drying is done, there's a little more moisture~. However. There are a lot of dry dishes in the Polish dishes and Portmeirion because they're warm. There's still moisture inside the plastic cups. The cooking utensils, such as the spoons at the very top, are also still wet. Next time, I'll have to wait until the wind noise is over.) When the dishes are done and the hot air drying is in progress, the dryer door is slightly open and warm air is blowing out~~. You have to warn the kids~~~. The wind isn't that~~~ hot~. I called the kid over and told her to be careful. She's a 5 year old and 42 months old girl. She's very curious~. "Warm wind is blowing~~ Put your hand up~ Warm wind is blowing? Be careful when the door is open because you could get hurt~". I told them~~. When I pushed the door closed while the hot air drying was in progress, it automatically opened again and the hot air drying continued~^^. Anyway, after going out and looking~~. The dishes were shiny~^^. It's originally made of porcelain, so it's shiny~~ but it feels like it's even shinier. The insides of the dishes are all dry and fluffy. Maybe because the cups weren't placed askew, there was some water on top. If I added more hot air drying time, they would all be dry~~. But in this era of high prices, if you organize the dishes, you can just quickly wipe them with a kitchen towel or a clean dishcloth~^^. There's a world of difference between not being able to use it because it doesn't have a hot air drying or steam function and not using it because you have it~. I have a separate dish dryer and sterilizer, but I didn't use it much before~ These days, the electricity and water bills are expensive. I think I should save money on things like this. But I don't really care about that and I think I'll just use the standard or automatic mode~. Anyway~~~~~ Since the dishwasher lady does the dishes~~. I'm able to spend more time with my child and I'm less annoyed with my husband. (I have to admit it.) But. FYI. The grease stains on my old stainless steel pot still remained even when I washed it with the standard detergent. This one. It doesn't come off even when I scrub it with a sponge~~. I was surprised that the stainless steel pots for kimchi stew, etc. were washed really cleanly~. I think using half a tablet and using the whole tablet make a difference in the dishwashing effect. Buy detergent in advance~. Rinse is for checking the water hardness(?). Litmus paper. Check for limescale in the water with something like that? Phew~~. I listened to the explanation~ I recorded it in a video.^^. You can buy salt specifically for dishwashers~~. If you buy an all-in-one detergent... Rinse and salt are optional, so I think it's okay without them~~. Anyway, among home appliances, I highly recommend the dishwasher next to the dryer. Please buy a dishwasher~~~~~~You absolutely must buy it! I have one child. I'm a full-time housewife, but I still bought one. Even if you're a full-time housewife, you should buy one~ But those who work, please, please, please buy one! I need to be happy myself first~~ Let's be happier^^. Comments (English): [ Very Quiet ] || ---------------- || I had this installed on 1/5/2023 and has been working good and very quiet. I also had noticed a white material hanging down below the door. My stove blew up on 11/17/2022 at 8 MONTHS old. It filled my house with smoke and awful electrical smell. Took 2 different companies to repair my stove, first one was shady, and finally 2 months and 2+ weeks everything was replaced. However, we spent Thanksgiving and Christmas with no oven or stove top. Nothing worked after it blew up. All they could say was the oven was made wrong in factory! One would think they would just replace it, but NO! I am wondering why I have a kitchen full of KitchenAid from a mixer, food processor, convection microwave, convection oven, dishwasher and so much more. They offered NOTHING while I had a dead oven that could have burned down my house. Ruined our holiday and made life difficult and I had to go out and buy a single burner, crockpot and a griddle. It is cold outside and snowing no way to just use our grill. Made me wonder why I spent over $4,000 updating my kitchen with KitchenAid. Thought it was my dream kitchen, but now it is nightmare! Looks good, but it has to work!

Sentence (English): This new GE profile DW replaces a similar GE model that was about 7 years old when it recently broke down.
Comments (English): [ So Far So Good.  ] || ---------------- || This new GE profile DW replaces a similar GE model that was about 7 years old when it recently broke down. When you look at new DW's, you see that they have many new neat features but the build quality across the board is pretty poor. Ends up being a bit of a gamble as to which one to buy. The DW runs really quiet and the internal layout of the two racks allows more items to fit than in previous model. It's only been a few weeks but so far so good. One thing to keep in mind that is not related to how the DW operates. On day of delivery, Home Depot would not install the dishwasher. Installer said we had to have a shut-off valve under sink which we did not have. We have PEX system which does have a shut-off vale on the PEX manifold. And it turned out that there also was a shutoff in the rear of the undercounter dishwasher compartment. But HD still would not install the dishwasher. So, we were left with the new dishwasher sitting in our kitchen and the old broken one still in place under counter. We are DIY people, and we installed the DW on our own. HD refunded our installation fee and the takeaway fee. and we later returned the installation parts we did not need. For us, it turned out OK and we saved $. But non DIY'ers would have been in a jam having to get an alternate installer that would almost certainly ending up costing them way for more to install. We are happy with the DW and would buy same unit again.

Sentence (English): I want to buy a 12-person large capacity, but I don't own one and it's burdensome to install, so after much thought, I decided on a 6-person one.
Comments (English): I want to buy a 12-person large capacity, but I don't own one and it's burdensome to install, so after much thought, I decided on a 6-person one. I moved to a remodeled house, but the somehow calm kitchen became so bright after bringing in the dishwasher >.<. Since the 12-person is installed at the bottom, I have to bend down to put in the dishes, but this product is placed right next to the sink, so it's very convenient to put in the dishes right away without bending down. One thing that's disappointing is that it doesn't have a function that opens the door after it's finished working. I still don't know how to play Tetris, so I can't put in a lot of dishes, but since I wash the dishes right after eating without putting them off, the stress of having to pile up the dishes has gone away. On days when there aren't many dishes, I put in a low pot, and it feels so refreshing. It's winter now, but I'm happy because I think I'll be able to wash the dishes even more cleanly in the summer~~~
Comments (Original): 마음은 거거익선이라 12인 큰용량을 들이고 싶지만 자가도 아니고 설치가 부담스러워서 많은 고민끝에 6인으로 결정했습니다.리모델링 한 집으로 이사하지만 뭔가 차분한 주방이 식세기 들이고 나니 너무 화사해졌어요 >.<12인은 하단에 설치하다보니 몸을 숙여서 그릇을 넣어야 하는데 이 제품은 싱크대 바로 옆에 놓다보니 숙이지 않고 바로 바로 그릇넣기 너무 편한 장점도 있습니다.한가지 아쉬운 부분은 작동 마치고 문이 열리는 기능이 없다는 부분이예요.....아직 테트리스 요령이 없어서 많은양의 그릇을 넣지는 못하지만 식사후 그릇 설거지 미루지 않고 바로 바로 세척하니 설거지 쌓아두는 스트레스가 날라갔습니다.그릇이 많이 안나오는 날은 높이 낮은 냄비도 넣어버리니 세상 속이 후련하네요ㅎㅎ지금은 겨울이지만, 여름에 더욱 청결하게 그릇세척이 가능할거라 생각하니 즐거워요~~~♬

Sentence (English): If you leave the dishwasher for a long time, there will be no problem with the metal part, but the rubber part may wear off and cause problems.
Comments (English): If you leave the dishwasher for a long time, there will be no problem with the metal part, but the rubber part may wear off and cause problems. It is expected to be a problem with the internal solenoid valve, but since the parts retention period has passed (usually 8 years), it seems difficult to expect repairs. If you try to repair it, you have to request a business trip service, and after disassembling and estimating the parts, if it doesn't work out, you have to look for another part replacement again. It will cost you time.

Comments (English): [ This dishwasher looks great, and does a good job washing.  ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher looks great, and does a good job washing dishes. Samsung had a technician come out who said it was installed properly, but was much louder than advertised. Samsung refused to send a replacement at this point. If you want a dishwasher that is 48dba, look for another brand or get one rated quieter.

Comments (English): [ This is THE ONE you need to buy! ] || ---------------- || I can't possibly say ENOUGH! I rarely write reviews, but I use them for most everything I purchase, and for this dishwasher I had to take the time to review it. Though this dishwasher doesn't have a drying element, it's no problem! I set it to \"Auto\" wash and \"Extra Dry\". The water gets so hot to clean the dishes that if you leave the door closed over night, you'll have sparkling clean and dry dishes the next morning! I just dab any standing water from the bottoms of glasses before I empty it. DONE. I will never own any other dishwasher for the rest of my life, and I had a few before this one. Not one comes any where near close. Don't think twice, just BUY IT.

Sentence (English): I mean, why do we buy dishwashers?
Comments (English): [ It actually cleans the dishes! ] || ---------------- || I mean, why do we buy dishwashers? To fill that gap between the kitchen cabinets? To waste huge amounts of electricity, soap, and water? To make obnoxiously loud noises in the kitchen? These are all things that my older, less expensive dishwasher did. We literally had to wash the dishes before loading them in the dishwasher (we called it pre-scrubbing because we were in denial). I bought this Bosch for our family after extensive research, and I mean I looked at a ton of different products in the same price range, read the reviews, etc. before making the purchase. This Bosch cleans the dishes so we don't have to. I have even put dishes in there that had food residue dried on them and it came off. The only thing it struggles with is cooked-on residue, but I'm willing to take a few seconds to knock that off before loading pots and pans. Other than that, I take the filter out and clean it every couple of days, because there is no hard food disposal, but again, I am ok with that. Compared to our old machine, this is minimal work. It cleans 99% of the dishes with no “pre-scrubbing” required. That alone justifies the product to me, that it fulfills its primary advertised purpose. Other nice-to-haves: it's quiet. Sentence (English): I purchased this Bosch 500 Dishwasher on 12/9/22 from Home Depot.
Comments (English): [ Good unit with some flaws ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch 500 Dishwasher on 12/9/22 from Home Depot. The packaging was very secure and the unit was perfect. No dents, scratches, etc. After reviewing many 500 DW videos on YouTube, I decided to do the installation myself. I purchased a kit from Amazon that included the drain hose, the electric plug, clamps, etc. I was happy to find that Bosch included the drain hose and electric cord and plug. I wish Bosch had included those in the description of the DW as it would have saved me money. The installation went smoothly but I must say you should take your time with that process. For example be certain you have a hole so that the drain hose is at the correct height (approx. 36") or else the water many not drain properly. The worst part was leveling the unit. It must be leveled in all three dimensions. The videos I saw all had two ways to adjust the legs. One is using a screwdriver tro move the rotating plastic piece (which, in my instance was just awful); and the other using an adjusting nut to turn the legs up or down. My unit had no such nuts. The screwdriver method was very difficult to use and I had to spray lubricant over and over again to get the rotating plastic piece to move. Once the oil loosened the wheel, I was able to get the unit leveled except for front to back which is off a tiny bit but acceptable. Once I hooked up the drain water to the garbage disposal and plugged in the electricity the unit started up promptly. I have since used the unit about 15 times and can say that it is very quit when running and does a great job of cleaning anything I put in it. It does take a while (on Auto) to finish up the job but that doesn't bother me as I use the time delay feature to get the unit running after midnight, when rates are low. Only negative comment is that the lower rack is poorly designed. I see many views of the 500 series where the lower rack has perfect "tines" to put in dishes. On my unit the left-hand half has tines that are oddly bend and are useless to put dishes into. I have no clue why Bosch did this, but they need to redesign that area.

One is using a screwdriver tro move the rotating plastic piece (which, in my instance was just awful); and the other using an adjusting nut to turn the legs up or down. My unit had no such nuts. Once I hooked up the drain water to the garbage disposal and plugged in the electricity the unit started up promptly. I have since used the unit about 15 times and can say that it is very quit when running and does a great job of cleaning anything I put in it. It does take a while (on Auto) to finish up the job but that doesn't bother me as I use the time delay feature to get the unit running after midnight, when rates are low. Sentence (English): I mean, why do we buy dishwashers?
Comments (English): [ It actually cleans the dishes! ] || ---------------- || I mean, why do we buy dishwashers? To fill that gap between the kitchen cabinets? To waste huge amounts of electricity, soap, and water? To make obnoxiously loud noises in the kitchen? These are all things that my older, less expensive dishwasher did. We literally had to wash the dishes before loading them in the dishwasher (we called it pre-scrubbing because we were in denial). I bought this Bosch for our family after extensive research, and I mean I looked at a ton of different products in the same price range, read the reviews, etc. before making the purchase.This Bosch cleans the dishes so we don't have to. I have even put dishes in there that had food residue dried on them and it came off. The only thing it struggles with is cooked-on residue, but I'm willing to take a few seconds to knock that off before loading pots and pans. Other than that, I take the filter out and clean it every couple of days, because there is no hard food disposal, but again, I am ok with that. Compared to our old machine, this is minimal work. It cleans 99% of the dishes with no “pre-scrubbing” required. That alone justifies the product to me, that it fulfills its primary advertised purpose.Other nice-to-haves: it's quiet. And when I say quiet, I mean I can't tell if it's running unless I'm right next to it, except that it shines a red dot on the floor as a visual cue. There is a feature that automatically pops the door open after the cycle ends, to help dry the dishes. The handle is recessed, which in my kitchen setup is necessary because there is no room for a towel bar. The controls are hidden, so my little “helpers” are less inclined to mash buttons and run it randomly or throw off the settings. It is very nice to look at and a nice addition to our kitchen. I installed it myself, and it wasn't any more difficult than any other dishwasher. The only real con is that there was a bit of a learning curve for me in terms of detergent, drying agent, etc. but that only took a few washes to get straightened out, and that was likely on me for never having owned a legit dishwasher before.I got a great deal buying open-box from Best Buy. YMMV if you go that route. There was no box (just bubble wrap) when I picked it up from my local store, we had to wait a few days for the power cord to ship to us, and the mounting brackets were missing so I had to buy those online (less than $20). It was still a great deal and a few months later we continue to be quite pleased with our purchase.

I just dab any standing water from the bottoms of glasses before I empty it. DONE. I will never own any other dishwasher for the rest of my life, and I had a few before this one. Not one comes any where near close. Don't think twice, just BUY IT.

Sentence (English): The first and foremost decision for this dishwasher was the Fingerprint resistant stainless steel front panel.
Comments (English): [ Extremely quite, thumbs up for utensils rack! ] || ---------------- || The first and foremost decision for this dishwasher was the Fingerprint resistant stainless steel front panel. The old Bosch DW was real SS and I could never keep it looking clean and good. Second was the -42db level. The Bosch was -48db and you barley could hear it. At -42db it is dead quite, the only noise you hear is the soap dish cover popping open. Another nice feature is the utensil rack that allows you not to have to use the utensil basket on the lowest rack. I removed it and it clears up a lot of space. There is one installation anomaly, if your sink is in the right side of the dishwasher, the drain hose was problematic that caused me a inadvertently knick the drain hose that caused it to leak. The hose exits the machine at the rear at the other end of the tub and the hose is snaked across the bottom. There is a clip to hold the hose in place but it pops out when maneuvering the machine into place and it gets behind the machine, therefore, you cannot insert the machine all the way in since the hose is blocking it. I drilled some holes in the clip and use zip ties to hold it in place at the highest setting and it was still below the base of the sink cabinet. It was not possible to slide in the DW into the position because of the hose would bind into the side of the cabinet. After getting a replacement hose, I drilled a hole below the base cabinet and in the floor of the cabinet. This allowed not having to use the clip and keep the drain hose down on the floor and it was easily maneuvered into the sink base. The side hole to the sink base need to be at the floor level. The electrical connection was easy but it is also on the other side of the DW. A dedicated slot to hold it in place worked well.

Another nice feature is the utensil rack that allows you not to have to use the utensil basket on the lowest rack. I removed it and it clears up a lot of space.  There is one installation anomaly, if your sink is in the right side of the dishwasher, the drain hose was problematic that caused me a inadvertently knick the drain hose that caused it to leak.  The hose exits the machine at the rear at the other end of the tub and the hose is snaked across the bottom.  There is a clip to hold the hose in place but it pops out when maneuvering the machine into place and it gets behind the machine, therefore, you cannot insert the machine all the way in since the hose is blocking it. I drilled some holes in the clip and use zip ties to hold it in place at the highest setting and it was still below the base of the sink cabinet.  It was not possible to slide in the DW into the position because of the hose would bind into the side of the cabinet. After getting a replacement hose, I drilled a hole below the base cabinet and in the floor of the cabinet.  This allowed not having to use the clip and keep the drain hose down on the floor and it was easily maneuvered into the sink base.  The side hole to the sink base need to be at the floor level. The electrical connection was easy but it is also on the other side of the DW. A dedicated slot to hold it in place worked well.
